en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a documentary on bugs
Watch a documentary on tennis players
Watch a documentary on the police

Does that mean...you'd rather get 
to know Gonta better?
No...it's fine.

I was just thinking...you're a 
pretty straightforward guy.

If I had someone like you, I might not 
have gotten...lost on my way in life.
Geez...

I thought I'd thrown it all away, but...
Seeing it now, I remember my glory days.

It's not like me to reminisce...
But, I want to swing a racket again...

Seeing this, I can't help remembering 
life inside my cell...

Was that...your intention, 
making me watch this?

Whatever... You can watch this 
by yourself.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Ryoma looks deep in thought...
(Hmph...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Ryoma's inner thoughts...?
